title: [ingest] Weight positive edge examples 8.5x more than negatives
summary: The edge classifier hard-codes class weights of 1.0 for class 0 and 8.5 for class 1. That is a deliberate recall bias for the positive edge class, and changing it would materially alter training behavior.
